description: The user edited an evaluator: the whole evaluator as written. A new id adds it to its book, switched on; a save to an evaluator already kept keeps its book.

book.description: The book the evaluator is kept with.

description.description: What the evaluator checks, for the chat. Left out, an evaluator already kept keeps the one it has and a new one has none.

journal.description: Listed in the journal's Evaluators as well as its own book's ("Show in journal"). Left out, an evaluator already kept keeps what it had and a new one is not listed there.

on.description: The question is switched on or off: a question switched off is kept but not asked. On when absent.

kind.description: yesno: a yes / no question. pick: one of the options is picked.

yes.description: What yes means, for a yesno question; empty for none.

no.description: What no means, for a yesno question; empty for none.

items.description: One option of a pick question.

name.description: The option as the user sees it.

description.description: What the option means; empty for none.

icon.description: The icon the option's mark gets on a choice point line, by its name in the icons (7.6); absent for none, so the mark is a check, or a warning when the option is not the one expected.

options.description: The options of a pick question; kept while the question is yesno, so switching back loses nothing.

expect.description: The answer expected: an option's id for a pick question, or yes or no for a yes / no question; absent when none is expected. A choice point mark is green when Jev gives it, red when not, uncoloured when absent.
